name: KindSlot
tagline: Free rewards platform for US users
desc_full:
KindSlot is a free-to-play online entertainment and rewards platform for users in the United States. Users can access browser-based activities, collect XP Points, track their progress, and redeem eligible rewards for digital gift cards according to the platform rules.

The platform is designed for simple participation, clear progress, and accessible online entertainment. Users do not need to download an app or install special software. No purchase is required to use KindSlot.
builder_bio: I work on KindSlot, a browser-based entertainment and rewards platform for US users. My focus is helping the project reach relevant communities and making the rewards experience easier to understand for new users.
builder_story: We built KindSlot to create a simple browser-based rewards experience for US users who enjoy casual online activities and want clear progress tracking. The goal is to make participation easy to understand, with XP Points, visible progress, and eligible digital gift card rewards in one place.
